This map shows a SkyTruth curated dataset of ships at sea that are either disabled or have sunk, and may be a threat to the environment due to their cargo (usually petroleum products). We picked these vessels because our team has been busy lately monitoring these locations, but why should we have all the fun?!?

Get started by clicking on a icon to view details about a vessel. Satellite imagery is key to monitoring, and you’ll need to first log into SkyTruth Alerts to access this feature from the left sidebar. While Sentinel 2 images are useful for visually following the path of a vessel, especially when clouds don’t get in the way, Sentinel 1 imagery provides the best tool to spot and measure oil slicks.
